# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU backends and new async APIs**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn alongside async pixel-readback APIs. This release introduces the next-generation Skia Graphite GPU pipeline, a `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` integration package, backend-neutral async `RequestReadPixels` on `SKImage` and `SKSurface`, FreeType-backed font support on Nano Server, and several performance improvements including optimized `SKData.SaveTo`.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m151 upstream stability fixes** — Two rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug-fix syncs land engine stability improvements into the bundled Skia build. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — The new Skia Graphite rendering pipeline is now bindable from C#. `SKGraphiteContext` and related types let you create a next-generation GPU context backed by Vulkan, Metal, or Dawn. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Async pixel-readback on SKImage and SKSurface** — `RequestReadPixels` provides a backend-neutral async path to read pixels from a GPU-backed image or surface without blocking the GPU timeline. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Performance: optimized SKData.SaveTo and reduced allocations** — `SKData.SaveTo` avoids a double buffer copy, `GetEncodedText` eliminates an intermediate string allocation in the null-terminated path, and `SKRuntimeEffectUniforms` pre-sizes its lookup map to the known uniform count. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Bug Fixes

- **Memory leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path** — A `CoTaskMem` pixel-buffer allocated during an `SKImage.Create` raster call was leaked when the call failed. The buffer is now freed correctly. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Platform

- **SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET integration package** — A new `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` NuGet package wires the SkiaSharp Vulkan backend to Silk.NET’s Vulkan bindings, and Vulkan integration tests now run on Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **FreeType font support on Nano Server** — Nano Server now uses FreeType for font rendering, resolving the long-standing issue where text could not be displayed in that environment. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Windows: stop pinning a Windows SDK version by default** — The native Windows build no longer pins a specific Windows SDK version, letting the installed SDK be used and reducing friction for contributors. ([#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588))
